```{r setup}
source("utils.R")
source("config_load.R")

# Full Bayesian RM ANOVA treatment: unlike the other Load scripts, this one
# reports and interprets BOTH main effects and the interaction. Per the
# approved Methods text, this uses specific bottom-up model comparisons
# (anovaBF ratios), same convention as the Flow/Castellar file — NOT
# bayesfactor_inclusion()/model averaging. BayesFactor already loaded via
# utils.R; no extra library needed here.

PARADIGM    <- "active"
MEASURE     <- "raw"
LOCK        <- "stim"
TRIALS      <- params$trials     # "correct" | "alltrials"
DATE_SOURCE <- "20261031"       # NULL = latest CSV; or pin a date, e.g. "20261031"
WINDOW      <- params$window
STIM        <- params$stim

AGGREGATE_BY_LATERALITY <- params$aggregate_by_laterality
included_participants   <- if (params$cohort == "n35") INCLUDED_ACTIVE_N35 else INCLUDED_ACTIVE

LATERALITY_ROW <- params$laterality_row

LATERALITY_MAP <- if (LATERALITY_ROW == "F_FC") {
  list(
    left    = c("F3",  "FC3"),
    central = c("Fz",  "FCz"),
    right   = c("F4",  "FC4")
  )
} else {
  list(
    left    = c("FC3", "C3"),
    central = c("FCz", "Cz"),
    right   = c("FC4", "C4")
  )
}

ALL_CHANNELS <- unlist(LATERALITY_MAP)


OUTPUT_RESULTS <- "L:/EEG_Flow_data/Study_EEG_Flow_Active/derivatives_v2/outputs/stats/load/laterality/"
DATA_ROOT      <- "L:/EEG_Flow_data/Study_EEG_Flow_Active/derivatives_v2/outputs/measures/load/"
DATE_STR       <- format(Sys.Date(), "%Y%m%d")


dir.create(OUTPUT_RESULTS, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

n         <- length(included_participants)
n_source  <- length(INCLUDED_ACTIVE)  # toujours 48
csv_path  <- find_stim_measures(DATA_ROOT, PARADIGM, "load", MEASURE, TRIALS, DATE_SOURCE)
csv_fname <- basename(csv_path)

df_all <- load_cluster_data(csv_path, CONDITION_MAP, included_participants)
cat("Loaded:", nrow(df_all), "rows |", n_distinct(df_all$participant), "participants\n")
cat("Windows available:", paste(sort(unique(df_all$window)), collapse=", "), "\n")
```

## Overview

```{r overview}
mode_label <- if (AGGREGATE_BY_LATERALITY) "Aggregated (left/central/right)" else "Individual electrodes"
cat(glue(
"**Paper**: LOAD - N2 Laterality  
**Paradigm**: ACTIVE  
**Stim**: {str_to_title(STIM)}  
**Window**: {WINDOW}  
**Trials**: {TRIALS}  
**CSV**: {csv_fname}  
**Electrodes**: {paste(ALL_CHANNELS, collapse=', ')}  
**Mode**: {mode_label}  
**Conditions**: {paste(CONDITION_LEVELS, collapse=' vs ')}  
**N participants**: {n}  
**Rendered**: {DATE_STR}  
"))
```

## Statistical Approach

This analysis reports and interprets all three effects of the 2-way repeated-measures ANOVA: the electrode/laterality main effect, the condition main effect, and their interaction (spatial specificity of the condition effect). Because all three are part of the story here — unlike the response-locked P3 or main Load-paper scripts, where electrode is completeness-only — a condition-only Bayesian companion (a simple paired t-test BF10) isn't sufficient on its own: it wouldn't say anything about the interaction or the electrode effect that are actually being discussed.

Per the study's Bayesian Methods (BayesFactor package, specific model comparisons rather than averaging across the full model space), we compute a `BayesFactor::anovaBF()` fit (`whichRandom = "participant"`) and derive each effect's BF10 from a targeted pair of models — the same bottom-up approach used in the Flow/Castellar analysis, not `bayesfactor_inclusion()`. Concretely: the electrode/laterality main effect and the condition main effect are each read directly from their own single-effect-vs-null model; the interaction is derived as BF(full model) / BF(main-effects-only model), which isolates exactly the variance the interaction term adds. All three are reported alongside the matching frequentist F/p/η²p rows (with Greenhouse-Geisser correction where Mauchly's test is significant, as before).

For the post-hoc pairwise comparisons (per electrode position, and on the merged laterality clusters), each is already a paired t-test, so we report `BayesFactor::ttestBF()` (JZS prior, r = .707) per the Methods text's post-hoc convention — same test, same prior, as everywhere else in these two papers.

**Right-lateralized merged post-hoc (FC2+C2)**: reported on the primary, pre-specified electrode cluster (FC1, C1, FCz, Cz, FC2, C2) — consistent with the cluster used for the main condition effect throughout, not switched for whichever electrode pair looked best. This is a single planned follow-up on a significant omnibus interaction, so it is reported **without correction** (unlike the per-position post-hoc across the 6 individual electrodes above, which stays Bonferroni-corrected). The wider cluster (FC3, C3, FCz, Cz, FC4, C4) is still computed below for internal reference, but is not a reported result — it isn't part of the manuscript and shouldn't be framed as an alternative or robustness check there.

## Analysis

```{r analysis, results='asis'}
apa_texts <- list()

df_base <- df_all %>%
  filter(stim == STIM, window == WINDOW, ch_name %in% ALL_CHANNELS) %>%
  mutate(condition = factor(condition, levels = CONDITION_LEVELS))

if (nrow(df_base) == 0) {
  cat(glue("> Warning: No data for stim='{STIM}', window='{WINDOW}'\n\n"))
  knitr::knit_exit()
}

if (AGGREGATE_BY_LATERALITY) {
  ch_to_lat <- stack(lapply(LATERALITY_MAP, function(chs) chs))
  names(ch_to_lat) <- c("ch_name", "laterality")
  ch_to_lat$ch_name    <- as.character(ch_to_lat$ch_name)
  ch_to_lat$laterality <- as.character(ch_to_lat$laterality)

  df_cond <- df_base %>%
    left_join(ch_to_lat, by = "ch_name") %>%
    group_by(participant, condition, laterality) %>%
    summarise(mean_amp_uv = mean(mean_amp_uv, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(laterality = factor(laterality, levels = c("left", "central", "right")))

  x_var <- "laterality"; x_label <- "Laterality"; within_var <- "laterality"
} else {
  df_cond <- df_base %>% mutate(ch_name = factor(ch_name, levels = ALL_CHANNELS))
  x_var <- "ch_name"; x_label <- "Electrode"; within_var <- "ch_name"
}

df_cond[["participant"]] <- factor(df_cond[["participant"]])  # needed for anovaBF's whichRandom

n_valid <- n_distinct(df_cond$participant)
cat(glue("N = {n_valid} participants\n\n"))

p <- df_cond %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = .data[[x_var]], y = mean_amp_uv, fill = condition)) +
  geom_boxplot(color = "black", outlier.shape = 21) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = CONDITION_COLORS, name = "Condition") +
  scale_y_reverse() +
  labs(
    title    = glue("N2 Laterality - {str_to_title(STIM)} | {WINDOW}"),
    subtitle = glue("N = {n_valid} | {if (AGGREGATE_BY_LATERALITY) 'Aggregated' else 'Individual electrodes'}"),
    x = x_label, y = "Mean amplitude (uV)"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 13) + theme(legend.position = "top")
print(p)
cat("\n")

label       <- glue("laterality_{STIM}_{WINDOW}_{if (AGGREGATE_BY_LATERALITY) 'agg' else 'ind'}")
formula_aov <- as.formula(glue("mean_amp_uv ~ {x_var} * condition"))
res_aov     <- aov(formula_aov, data = df_cond)
resids      <- residuals(res_aov)
shapiro     <- shapiro.test(resids)


cat(glue("**Shapiro-Wilk** (residuals): W = {round(as.numeric(shapiro$statistic), 3)}, p = {round(as.numeric(shapiro$p.value), 3)}\n\n"))

res_rm <- anova_test(
  data = df_cond, dv = mean_amp_uv, wid = participant,
  within = c(within_var, "condition"), type = 2, effect.size = "pes"
)

cat("**Repeated-measures ANOVA (GGe corrected where applicable):**\n\n")
print(knitr::kable(get_anova_table(res_rm, correction = "auto"), digits = 3))
cat("\n")

gg <- res_rm$`Sphericity Corrections`
if (!is.null(gg) && nrow(gg) > 0) {
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(gg))) {
    eff <- gg$Effect[i]
    eps <- round(gg$GGe[i], 2)
    cat(glue("**GGe epsilon ({eff})**: epsilon = {eps}  \n\n"))
  }
}

mauchly <- res_rm$`Mauchly's Test for Sphericity`
if (!is.null(mauchly) && nrow(mauchly) > 0) {
  cat("**Mauchly's Test for Sphericity:**\n\n")
  print(knitr::kable(mauchly, digits = 3))
  cat("\n")
}
if (!is.null(gg)) {
  cat("**Sphericity Corrections (GGe and HFe):**\n\n")
  print(knitr::kable(gg, digits = 3))
  cat("> GGe correction applied where Mauchly's test was significant (p < .05)\n\n")
}

# ── Bayesian RM ANOVA (specific model comparisons, matching Flow/Castellar) ──
# Per the approved Methods text: anovaBF is used to compare specific models
# of interest (a given main effect vs. the null; the full model vs. the
# main-effects-only model for the interaction) — NOT averaged across the
# full model space (i.e. NOT bayesfactor_inclusion()).
bf_lookup <- tryCatch({
  bf_formula <- as.formula(glue("mean_amp_uv ~ {x_var} * condition + participant"))
  bf_models  <- BayesFactor::anovaBF(
    bf_formula,
    data        = df_cond,
    whichRandom = "participant",
    whichModels = "withmain",
    progress    = FALSE
  )

  bf_df <- as.data.frame(bf_models)
  bf_df$model <- rownames(bf_df)

  normalize_term <- function(term) {
    if (grepl(":", term)) {
      parts <- sort(trimws(strsplit(term, ":")[[1]]))
      paste(parts, collapse = ":")
    } else {
      trimws(term)
    }
  }

  get_bf_for_model <- function(target_terms) {
    target_norm <- sort(sapply(target_terms, normalize_term))
    terms_list  <- strsplit(bf_df$model, "\\s*\\+\\s*")
    matches <- sapply(terms_list, function(terms) {
      setequal(sort(sapply(terms, normalize_term)), target_norm)
    })
    if (sum(matches) != 1) {
      warning(glue("Expected exactly 1 match for terms {paste(target_terms, collapse=', ')}, found {sum(matches)}. Model names were: {paste(bf_df$model, collapse='; ')}"))
      return(NA)
    }
    bf_df$bf[matches]
  }

  bf_xvar        <- get_bf_for_model(c(x_var, "participant"))
  bf_condition   <- get_bf_for_model(c("condition", "participant"))
  bf_maineffects <- get_bf_for_model(c(x_var, "condition", "participant"))
  bf_full        <- get_bf_for_model(c(x_var, "condition", glue("{x_var}:condition"), "participant"))
  bf_interaction <- bf_full / bf_maineffects

  setNames(c(bf_xvar, bf_condition, bf_interaction),
           c(x_var, "condition", glue("{x_var}:condition")))
}, error = function(e) {
  cat(glue("> Warning: Bayesian ANOVA failed: {e$message}\n\n"))
  NULL
})

# Match a term name to a bf_lookup name, trying both interaction orders
# (BayesFactor and rstatix don't always name interactions in the same order).
match_bf_term <- function(term, lookup) {
  if (is.null(lookup)) return(NA_character_)
  if (term %in% names(lookup)) return(term)
  if (grepl(":", term)) {
    alt <- paste(rev(strsplit(term, ":")[[1]]), collapse = ":")
    if (alt %in% names(lookup)) return(alt)
  }
  NA_character_
}

if (!is.null(bf_lookup)) {
  cat("**Bayesian RM ANOVA (specific model comparisons):**\n\n")
  print(knitr::kable(data.frame(Effect = names(bf_lookup), BF10 = as.numeric(bf_lookup)), digits = 3)); cat("\n")
}

tbl <- get_anova_table(res_rm, correction = "auto")
for (i in seq_len(nrow(tbl))) {
  row   <- tbl[i, ]
  term  <- row$Effect
  f_val <- round(as.numeric(row$F), 2)
  df1   <- row$DFn; df2 <- row$DFd
  p_val <- as.numeric(row$p)
  eta   <- round(as.numeric(row$pes), 3)
  p_str <- format_p(p_val)
  gg_note <- ""
  if (!is.null(gg) && term %in% gg$Effect) {
    eps <- round(gg$GGe[gg$Effect == term], 2)
    mauchly_p <- mauchly$p[mauchly$Effect == term]
    if (!is.null(mauchly_p) && as.numeric(mauchly_p) < .05)
      gg_note <- glue(", GGe corrected, epsilon = {eps}")
  }
  bf_note <- ""
  bf_term <- match_bf_term(term, bf_lookup)
  if (!is.na(bf_term)) {
    bf_note <- glue(", BF10 = {format_bf(bf_lookup[[bf_term]])}")
  }
  apa <- glue("{term}: F({df1}, {df2}) = {f_val}, {p_str}, pes = {eta}{gg_note}{bf_note}")
  cat(glue("- {apa}\n"))
  apa_texts[[term]] <- apa
}
cat("\n")

cat("**Post-hoc** (condition per position, Bonferroni):\n\n")
posthoc <- df_cond %>%
  group_by(.data[[x_var]]) %>%
  pairwise_t_test(mean_amp_uv ~ condition, paired = TRUE, p.adjust.method = "bonferroni")
print(knitr::kable(posthoc, digits = 3))
cat("\n")

posthoc_bf_list <- list()
for (i in seq_len(nrow(posthoc))) {
  row   <- posthoc[i, ]
  pos   <- as.character(row[[x_var]])
  p_val <- as.numeric(row$p.adj)
  p_str <- format_p(p_val)
  stats <- df_cond %>%
    filter(!!sym(x_var) == pos) %>%
    group_by(condition) %>%
    summarise(M = round(mean(mean_amp_uv, na.rm=TRUE), 2),
              SD = round(sd(mean_amp_uv, na.rm=TRUE), 2), .groups="drop")
  m1 <- stats$M[stats$condition == CONDITION_LEVELS[1]]
  sd1 <- stats$SD[stats$condition == CONDITION_LEVELS[1]]
  m2 <- stats$M[stats$condition == CONDITION_LEVELS[2]]
  sd2 <- stats$SD[stats$condition == CONDITION_LEVELS[2]]

  # Bayesian companion for this position's paired comparison
  df_pos_wide <- df_cond %>%
    filter(!!sym(x_var) == pos) %>%
    pivot_wider(id_cols = participant, names_from = condition,
                values_from = mean_amp_uv, names_prefix = "mean_amp_uv.") %>%
    mutate(across(starts_with("mean_amp_uv."), as.numeric)) %>%
    drop_na()
  pos_bf <- tryCatch(run_paired_ttest(df_pos_wide, CONDITION_LEVELS), error = function(e) NULL)
  posthoc_bf_list[[pos]] <- pos_bf
  bf_str <- if (!is.null(pos_bf)) glue(", BF10 = {format_bf(pos_bf$bf10)}, BF01 = {format_bf(pos_bf$bf01)}") else ""

  apa_ph <- glue(
    "{pos}: {CONDITION_LEVELS[1]} (M={m1}, SD={sd1}) vs ",
    "{CONDITION_LEVELS[2]} (M={m2}, SD={sd2}), ",
    "t({row$df}) = {round(as.numeric(row$statistic), 2)}, {p_str}{bf_str}"
  )
  cat(glue("- {apa_ph}\n"))
  apa_texts[[glue("posthoc_{pos}")]] <- apa_ph
}
cat("\n")
```
## Post-hoc — merged pairs

*Note on "merged" clusters: electrodes within a merge pair are __averaged__ (`mean(mean_amp_uv)`), not summed — same convention as every other cluster in this pipeline. "FC2 + C2" below means the FC2/C2 average, not their literal sum.*

*Only `right2` (FC2+C2) is a reported result — it's the primary, pre-specified cluster's right-lateralized follow-up, reported without correction (single planned comparison after a significant omnibus interaction). The other merge groups, including the wider cluster (`right` = FC4+C4), are computed here for internal reference only and are not part of the manuscript.*

```{r posthoc-merged, results='asis'}
MERGE_MAP <- list(
  "left"    = c("FC3", "C3"),
  "midline" = c("FCz", "Cz"),
  "right"   = c("FC4", "C4"),
  "left2"    = c("FC1", "C1"),
  "right2"  = c("FC2", "C2")
)

cat("**Post-hoc — merged electrode pairs (reported: right2/FC2+C2 only, uncorrected; others for internal reference):**\n\n")

posthoc_merged_bf_list <- list()
for (merge_label in names(MERGE_MAP)) {
  chs <- MERGE_MAP[[merge_label]]

  df_merged <- df_all %>%
    filter(stim == STIM, window == WINDOW, ch_name %in% chs) %>%
    group_by(participant, condition) %>%
    summarise(mean_amp_uv = mean(mean_amp_uv, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(condition = factor(condition, levels = CONDITION_LEVELS))
  
  # Guard — skip if not enough data
  n_per_cond <- table(df_merged$condition)
  if (any(n_per_cond < 3)) {
    cat(glue("> Warning: not enough data for {merge_label} ({paste(chs, collapse='+')}) — skipping\n\n"))
    next
  }

  # Uncorrected: this is a single planned follow-up on the primary cluster,
  # not a family of comparisons being searched (see "Statistical Approach").
  ph <- df_merged %>%
    pairwise_t_test(mean_amp_uv ~ condition, paired = TRUE,
                    p.adjust.method = "none")

  stats <- df_merged %>%
    group_by(condition) %>%
    summarise(M  = round(mean(mean_amp_uv, na.rm=TRUE), 2),
              SD = round(sd(mean_amp_uv,   na.rm=TRUE), 2), .groups="drop")

  m1  <- stats$M[stats$condition  == CONDITION_LEVELS[1]]
  sd1 <- stats$SD[stats$condition == CONDITION_LEVELS[1]]
  m2  <- stats$M[stats$condition  == CONDITION_LEVELS[2]]
  sd2 <- stats$SD[stats$condition == CONDITION_LEVELS[2]]

  p_str  <- format_p(as.numeric(ph$p.adj))
  t_val  <- round(as.numeric(ph$statistic), 2)
  df_val <- ph$df

  # Bayesian companion for this merged-pair comparison
  df_merged_wide <- df_merged %>%
    pivot_wider(id_cols = participant, names_from = condition,
                values_from = mean_amp_uv, names_prefix = "mean_amp_uv.") %>%
    mutate(across(starts_with("mean_amp_uv."), as.numeric)) %>%
    drop_na()
  merged_bf <- tryCatch(run_paired_ttest(df_merged_wide, CONDITION_LEVELS), error = function(e) NULL)
  posthoc_merged_bf_list[[merge_label]] <- merged_bf
  bf_str <- if (!is.null(merged_bf)) glue(", BF10 = {format_bf(merged_bf$bf10)}, BF01 = {format_bf(merged_bf$bf01)}") else ""

  apa_ph <- glue(
    "{merge_label} ({paste(chs, collapse='+')}): ",
    "{CONDITION_LEVELS[1]} (M={m1}, SD={sd1}) vs ",
    "{CONDITION_LEVELS[2]} (M={m2}, SD={sd2}), ",
    "t({df_val}) = {t_val}, {p_str}{bf_str}"
  )
  cat(glue("- {apa_ph}\n\n"))
  apa_texts[[glue("posthoc_merged_{merge_label}")]] <- apa_ph
}
```

```{r save-summary}
fname_suffix <- glue("{if (AGGREGATE_BY_LATERALITY) 'agg' else 'ind'}_{STIM}_{LATERALITY_ROW}_{TRIALS}")

# ANOVA results (+ inclusion BF, matched to Effect where available)
anova_tbl <- get_anova_table(res_rm, correction = "auto")
anova_df  <- data.frame(
  Effect   = anova_tbl$Effect,
  DFn      = anova_tbl$DFn,
  DFd      = anova_tbl$DFd,
  F        = anova_tbl$F,
  p        = anova_tbl$p,
  pes      = anova_tbl$pes,
  analysis = "ANOVA",
  config   = if (AGGREGATE_BY_LATERALITY) "aggregated" else "individual"
)
anova_df[["BF10"]] <- NA_real_
if (!is.null(bf_lookup)) {
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(anova_df))) {
    bf_term <- match_bf_term(anova_df$Effect[i], bf_lookup)
    if (!is.na(bf_term)) anova_df[["BF10"]][i] <- round(bf_lookup[[bf_term]], 3)
  }
}

# Post-hoc results (+ BF10/BF01 per position)
posthoc_df <- posthoc %>%
  mutate(
    analysis = "posthoc_bonferroni",
    config   = if (AGGREGATE_BY_LATERALITY) "aggregated" else "individual"
  )
posthoc_df[["BF10"]] <- NA_real_
posthoc_df[["BF01"]] <- NA_real_
for (i in seq_len(nrow(posthoc_df))) {
  pos <- as.character(posthoc_df[[x_var]][i])
  bf  <- posthoc_bf_list[[pos]]
  if (!is.null(bf)) {
    posthoc_df[["BF10"]][i] <- round(bf$bf10, 3)
    posthoc_df[["BF01"]][i] <- round(bf$bf01, 3)
  }
}

# Post-hoc merged (+ BF10/BF01 per merge group) — uncorrected, single
# planned comparisons; right2 (FC2+C2) is the only reported one.
posthoc_merged_df <- bind_rows(lapply(names(MERGE_MAP), function(lbl) {
  chs <- MERGE_MAP[[lbl]]
  df_tmp <- df_all %>%
    dplyr::filter(stim == STIM, window == WINDOW, ch_name %in% chs) %>% 
    dplyr::group_by(participant, condition) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(mean_amp_uv = mean(mean_amp_uv, na.rm=TRUE), .groups="drop") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(condition = factor(condition, levels = CONDITION_LEVELS))
  
  n_per_cond <- table(df_tmp$condition)
  if (any(n_per_cond < 3)) return(NULL)
  
  out <- df_tmp %>%
    pairwise_t_test(mean_amp_uv ~ condition, paired=TRUE, p.adjust.method="none") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(merge_group = lbl, electrodes = paste(chs, collapse="_"))

  bf <- posthoc_merged_bf_list[[lbl]]
  out[["BF10"]] <- if (!is.null(bf)) round(bf$bf10, 3) else NA_real_
  out[["BF01"]] <- if (!is.null(bf)) round(bf$bf01, 3) else NA_real_
  out
}))

# Means and SDs per position
means_df <- df_cond %>%
  group_by(.data[[x_var]], condition) %>%
  summarise(M = round(mean(mean_amp_uv, na.rm=TRUE), 3),
            SD = round(sd(mean_amp_uv, na.rm=TRUE), 3),
            .groups = "drop")

# write.csv(anova_df,
#           file.path(OUTPUT_RESULTS, glue("active_load_laterality_{fname_suffix}_anova_{DATE_STR}.csv")),
#           row.names = FALSE)
# write.csv(posthoc_df,
#           file.path(OUTPUT_RESULTS, glue("active_load_laterality_{fname_suffix}_posthoc_{DATE_STR}.csv")),
#           row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(posthoc_merged_df,
          file.path(OUTPUT_RESULTS, glue("active_load_laterality_{fname_suffix}_posthoc_merged_{DATE_STR}.csv")),
          row.names = FALSE)
# write.csv(means_df,
#           file.path(OUTPUT_RESULTS, glue("active_load_laterality_{fname_suffix}_means_{DATE_STR}.csv")),
#           row.names = FALSE)
cat("Summaries saved.\n")
```
